ecological_question: Within the same route, are species that were historically intermittent participants more likely to appear on the wetter side of later matched wet–dry surveys?
rationale: Species-level recurrence averaged across the range was null. A more local ecological mechanism is that rainfall recruits species that are already part of a route's historical active pool but are usually inactive there.

common_run_eligibility.temperature: >=8 valid stop temperatures and mean [-10,45] C

baseline_local_history.include_species_if: species detected in >=1 eligible baseline run on that route
baseline_local_history.recurrence: active baseline runs / eligible baseline runs on route
baseline_local_history.interpretation: local historical recurrence within a route where the species had already been acoustically observed

validation_events.pairing: 2008-2015 only; State × RouteNumber × RunNumber adjacent observed years; orient lower DaysSinceRain as wetter
validation_events.discordant_species_event: For each pair and species present in exactly one run, y=1 if wetter-only, y=0 if drier-only.
validation_events.include_event_if: species × route has eligible baseline local history under the frozen rule
validation_events.repeated_unit: species × route may contribute multiple validation pairs

primary_model.formula: y ~ baseline_local_recurrence_logit + rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(species) + C(route_cluster) + C(RunNumber)
primary_model.hypothesis: Locally intermittent historical members are more likely than locally recurrent members to be the species appearing only in the wetter run.

secondary_interaction.interpretation: Larger rain contrasts preferentially recruit locally intermittent historical members.

exact_consecutive_year_sensitivity.rule: Repeat primary model on validation pairs with year_gap=1.

descriptives: median baseline recurrence among wet-only versus dry-only events
fraction of all wet-only validation events whose species was known from the route's baseline period
fraction of all dry-only validation events whose species was known from the route's baseline period

predictions.P1: Primary baseline-local-recurrence coefficient <0 with 95% CI excluding 0.
predictions.P3: If supported, rainfall-associated reassembly preferentially draws locally intermittent historical members into the active assemblage rather than simply amplifying the locally recurrent core.

boundaries: Historical detection on a route is evidence of prior acoustic participation, not proof of continuous occupancy.
A wet-only event is acoustic recruitment, not colonization.
No rainfall causality, abundance, occupancy, breeding success, or extinction claim.
No alternate recurrence definition, baseline window, or model family may be opened after readback.
